terminology_policy.translate: Parameters.parameter contains result/valueBoolean plus every match, each with part equivalence/valueCode and concept/valueCoding(system,version,code,display). Exclude disjoint/unmatched and unmet dependsOn targets. No match => false, no match parts.
terminology_policy.validate_code: Parameters.parameter=[{name:'result',valueBoolean:bool}]. Case-sensitive codes; supplied display must exactly match; activeOnly rejects inactive concepts; valueSet restricts membership if supplied.
terminology_policy.version: Exact system and version. No external lookups, cross-system display matching or version fallback.

validation_policy.binding: CodeableConcept succeeds if any coding is an active member of the version-pinned ValueSet. An omitted coding.version uses the ValueSet version; an explicit mismatch fails. Required failure is error/code-invalid; extensible failure is warning/code-invalid.
validation_policy.completeness: Report every independent finding, preserving multiplicity. An absent value gets only a minimum-cardinality issue, not a spurious type/fixed-value issue.
validation_policy.conformant: Exactly one information/informational issue at the profile's resource type.
validation_policy.constraint: code=invariant; severity from the constraint; details.coding=[{system:'urn:ops:constraint',code:constraint.key}]. No details are required for other findings.
validation_policy.location: issue.expression is a one-element array containing the differential element.path; reference-policy issues use the complete referring FHIRPath, including list indexes.
validation_policy.references: Only when the task step requests it: every reference must exactly match a ResourceType/id in the declared folder, else error/not-found.
validation_policy.scope: Only explicit differential rules; baseDefinition identifies R4 4.0.1 but inherited base rules, slicing and unlisted constraints are outside this exercise.

Do not treat a false translation result as successful mapping or suppress other diagnostics. No intermediate files. Read only the declared inputs listed in task.json. Write exactly result.json, sanitized.json, validation.json to a fresh output folder; do not retain logs, raw copies, or intermediate files. Follow the versioned whole-output contract. Use the pinned owned fixtures, not an external terminology service. The source folder is synthetic and immutable.
